### Exercício 1:

As estatísticas são o número de voos atrasados (ARRIVAL_DELAY \> 10) e o número total de voos válidos, agrupados por mês, dia e companhia aérea.

## Exercício 2:

```{r}
library(dplyr)

getStats <- function(input, pos) {
  input %>%
    filter(AIRLINE %in% c("AA", "DL", "UA", "US"),
           !is.na(ARRIVAL_DELAY)) %>%
    group_by(MONTH,
             DAY,
             AIRLINE) %>%
    summarise(atrasados = sum(ARRIVAL_DELAY > 10),
              total = n(), .groups = "drop")
}
```

## Questão 3:

```{r}
library(readr)

stats <- read_csv_chunked(
  "flights.csv",
  DataFrameCallback$new(getStats),
  chunk_size = 100000,
  col_types = cols_only(MONTH = col_integer(),
                        DAY = col_integer(),
                        AIRLINE = col_character(),
                        ARRIVAL_DELAY = col_double())
)
```

## Questão 4:

```{r}
computeStats <- function(stats) {
  stats %>%
    group_by(MONTH,
             DAY,
             AIRLINE) %>%
    summarise(atrasados = sum(atrasados),
              total = sum(total),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(Cia = AIRLINE,
           Data = as.Date(paste(2015, MONTH, DAY, sep = "-")),
           Perc = atrasados / total) %>%
    select(Cia,
           Data,
           Perc)
}

stats <- computeStats(stats)
```

## Questão 5:

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

pal <- scale_fill_gradient(
  low = "#4575b4",
  high = "#d73027"
)

baseCalendario <- function(stats, cia) {
  stats %>%
    filter(Cia == cia) %>%
    mutate(semana = as.numeric(format(Data, "%U")),
           dia_semana = as.numeric(format(Data, "%w")))
}

cAA <- baseCalendario(stats, "AA")
cDL <- baseCalendario(stats, "DL")
cUA <- baseCalendario(stats, "UA")
cUS <- baseCalendario(stats, "US")

ggplot(cAA,
       aes(x = dia_semana,
           y = semana,
           fill = Perc)) +
  geom_tile() +
  pal +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:6,
                     labels = c("Dom", "Seg", "Ter", "Qua", "Qui", "Sex", "Sáb")) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  ggtitle("Percentual de voos atrasados - AA") +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = NULL,
       fill = "Atrasos") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(cDL, aes(x = dia_semana,
                y = semana,
                fill = Perc)) +
  geom_tile() +
  pal +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:6,
                     labels = c("Dom", "Seg", "Ter", "Qua", "Qui", "Sex", "Sáb")) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  ggtitle("Percentual de voos atrasados - DL") +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = NULL,
       fill = "Atrasos") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(cUA, aes(x = dia_semana,
                y = semana,
                fill = Perc)) +
  geom_tile() +
  pal +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:6,
                     labels = c("Dom", "Seg", "Ter", "Qua", "Qui", "Sex", "Sáb")) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  ggtitle("Percentual de voos atrasados - UA") +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = NULL,
       fill = "Atrasos") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(cUS, aes(x = dia_semana,
                y = semana,
                fill = Perc)) +
  geom_tile() +
  pal +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:6,
                     labels = c("Dom", "Seg", "Ter", "Qua", "Qui", "Sex", "Sáb")) +
  scale_y_reverse() +

```
